summary: Implemented the M16 two-phase controlled-update execution path with fixed APT/systemd commands, durable pre-dispatch identity, bounded reconciliation, verification, and deterministic fake-executor coverage; no configured device was changed.
completed: Amended the canonical contract with the explicit PREPARE then consent-gated APPLY boundary; a plan fingerprint is an immediate pre-dispatch consent gate, not an atomic lock.

Added typed capability, dpkg audit, metadata-refresh, simulation, detached systemd-run, one-shot systemctl, journal-tail, and cleanup operations with fixed arguments, environment, output limits, and diagnostics labels.
Implemented fresh plan persistence and SHA-256 plan comparison; changed plans persist the refreshed M15 result and terminate as PlanChanged before dispatch.
Persisted Dispatching before dispatch, never retries uncertain dispatch, reconciles only the recorded transient unit, and leaves an unexpired active unit running without a kill/timeout path.
Added terminal dpkg and internal M15 verification, conservative reboot state, bounded/discarded journal diagnostics, terminal Activity, and operation-scoped expected-disruption cleanup.

Added deterministic fake-executor cases for phases, unsafe preflight, busy refresh, changed plan, systemctl classification, uncertain dispatch, recovery expiry, no redispatch, and no raw output persistence.
